candidates.name: Palo Alto Networks
candidates.description: Provides a comprehensive cybersecurity platform that secures cloud workloads and applications, overlapping with Snyk's developer-first security mission.
candidates.rationale: Palo Alto’s Prisma Cloud secures applications, code, containers, and cloud workloads, targeting the same AppSec and DevSecOps buyers as Snyk.

candidates.name: Rapid7
candidates.description: Offers a unified cybersecurity platform that includes application security testing and vulnerability management across the development lifecycle.
candidates.rationale: Rapid7 overlaps Snyk in application security testing and vulnerability management, serving security and development teams across the software development lifecycle.

candidates.name: Checkmarx
candidates.description: Specializes in agentic application security testing and hybrid scanning to identify vulnerabilities within codebases similar to Snyk.
candidates.rationale: Checkmarx offers application security testing for code vulnerabilities, serving the same developer and AppSec buyers and overlapping Snyk’s core use cases.

candidates.name: Veracode, Inc.
candidates.description: Provides an application risk management platform designed to secure software throughout the development lifecycle.
candidates.rationale: Veracode offers application security and vulnerability management across the software development lifecycle, serving the same security and development buyers as Snyk.

candidates.name: SonarSource
candidates.description: Offers an AI-powered code verification and quality platform that focuses on secure coding practices for developers.
candidates.rationale: Both provide developer-first code analysis platforms that identify security issues and support secure software development within engineering workflows.

candidates.name: Endor Labs Inc.
candidates.description: Provides an AI-native application security platform specifically focused on dependency management and securing AI-generated code.
candidates.rationale: Both provide developer-focused application security for identifying and remediating software dependency and code vulnerabilities, targeting the same AppSec and engineering buyers.

candidates.name: Cycode Ltd.
candidates.description: Operates an agentic development security platform that focuses on securing the entire software supply chain from code to cloud.
candidates.rationale: Cycode offers developer-focused application and software supply-chain security from code to cloud, overlapping Snyk’s capabilities and targeting the same security teams.

candidates.name: Invicti Security Corp
candidates.description: Provides automated web application and API security testing that scales for enterprise-grade software development.
candidates.rationale: Both provide developer-focused application security testing integrated into software development, serving security and engineering teams seeking vulnerability detection and remediation.

candidates.name: Aquasec
candidates.description: Delivers a cloud-native security platform that secures containers and serverless applications, mirroring Snyk's infrastructure-as-code security focus.
candidates.rationale: Both provide developer-focused cloud-native application security, including container and infrastructure-as-code vulnerability protection, targeting overlapping DevSecOps buyers.

candidates.name: Sysdig, Inc.
candidates.description: Focuses on cloud security and runtime visibility to secure applications from the development phase through to production.
candidates.rationale: Sysdig offers cloud-native application security across development and runtime, overlapping Snyk’s container and cloud security for DevSecOps buyers.

candidates.name: Contrast Security Inc.
candidates.description: Provides runtime application security platforms that observe code behavior to detect vulnerabilities in real-time.
candidates.rationale: Both offer developer-focused application security platforms for detecting and remediating software vulnerabilities, targeting overlapping AppSec and engineering buyers.

candidates.name: ArmorCode Inc.
candidates.description: Offers a unified exposure management platform that helps security teams prioritize and remediate application-layer risks.
candidates.rationale: Both provide application-security platforms that help security teams identify, prioritize, and remediate software vulnerabilities and exposure risks.

candidates.name: JFrog Ltd
candidates.description: Provides software supply chain solutions that manage binaries and security in the DevOps pipeline, overlapping with Snyk's pipeline security offerings.
candidates.rationale: JFrog offers DevSecOps and software supply chain security for vulnerabilities in binaries, dependencies, and pipelines, targeting the same developer-security buyers.

candidates.name: GitLab Inc.
candidates.description: Integrates DevSecOps tooling directly into the development platform, including AI-driven security scanning features.
candidates.rationale: GitLab’s integrated DevSecOps security scanning overlaps Snyk’s vulnerability detection and remediation, targeting the same development and application-security teams.

candidates.name: GitHub
candidates.description: Provides native security features like Advanced Security for code scanning and dependency vulnerability management within the developer platform.
candidates.rationale: GitHub Advanced Security overlaps Snyk’s developer-focused code scanning and dependency vulnerability management, serving the same application-security and engineering buyers.

candidates.name: Obsidian Security Inc.
candidates.description: Delivers end-to-end SaaS security and configuration management to protect enterprise application environments.
candidates.rationale: Obsidian secures enterprise SaaS applications and configurations, while Snyk targets developer code, dependencies, containers, and infrastructure; distinct security jobs and evaluations.

candidates.name: Pentera Security Ltd.
candidates.description: Uses AI-driven automated testing to validate application and network exposure, similar to how Snyk tests for vulnerabilities.
candidates.rationale: Pentera provides automated penetration testing and security validation, not developer-focused code, dependency, container, and IaC vulnerability remediation.

candidates.name: Synopsys, Inc.
candidates.description: Provides an extensive suite of software integrity tools for application security testing and supply chain analysis.
candidates.rationale: Synopsys offers application security testing and software supply-chain analysis tools evaluated by the same developer security and AppSec buyers as Snyk.

candidates.name: Deepfence Inc.
candidates.description: Offers a cloud-native application protection platform (CNAPP) that secures workloads and applications across the development lifecycle.
candidates.rationale: Both provide developer-focused cloud-native application security, including vulnerability protection for workloads, containers, and applications across the development lifecycle.

candidates.name: CloudBees
candidates.description: Provides software delivery solutions that integrate security and context-aware governance into the enterprise CI/CD process.
candidates.rationale: CloudBees primarily provides CI/CD and software delivery, not vulnerability detection and remediation; its embedded governance does not directly substitute for Snyk.

candidates.name: Sprinto Technology Private Limited
candidates.description: Automates compliance and risk monitoring for software companies, focusing on the security posture of the development environment.
candidates.rationale: Sprinto provides compliance automation and risk monitoring, not developer-focused vulnerability detection and remediation across code, dependencies, containers, and cloud infrastructure.

candidates.name: Vanta Inc.
candidates.description: Automates the compliance and security audit process for software companies by monitoring their technical infrastructure.
candidates.rationale: Vanta automates compliance audits and evidence collection, while Snyk provides developer-focused vulnerability scanning and remediation; their core jobs differ.

candidates.name: Qualys
candidates.description: Provides an enterprise security platform that covers vulnerability management and cloud security, often used in development-heavy environments.
candidates.rationale: Both provide enterprise vulnerability and cloud-security platforms, with overlapping remediation workflows and security/DevSecOps buyers.

candidates.name: Tenable Network Security, Inc.
candidates.description: Leader in exposure management and vulnerability assessment across cloud and traditional software environments.
candidates.rationale: Both sell vulnerability and exposure management platforms spanning cloud/software environments to security teams, with overlapping assessment and remediation use cases.

candidates.name: SecurityPal, Inc.
candidates.description: Automates the security review and vendor risk assessment process for software companies using AI agents.
candidates.rationale: SecurityPal automates vendor security reviews, while Snyk detects and remediates software vulnerabilities; their core jobs and evaluators differ.
